source: Phase 1 normalized_core.npz angle curves (101-pt). Angular velocity is NOT stored; Hilbert phase uses the analytic signal of the demeaned angle and does not require an explicit velocity channel.
crp_method_rationale: Instantaneous phase from the Hilbert analytic signal of the demeaned joint-angle time series (Lamb & Stöckl / Hamill CRP tradition). Preferred over atan2(ω, θ) phase-plane because the latter requires separate normalization of position and velocity and is sensitive to those choices; Hilbert phase is uniquely defined for a demeaned real signal without an extra velocity scale.
velocity_audit: Phase 1 stores position-like angle trajectories only (no KinAngVel). Finite-difference/SG velocity can be derived (Phase 2 does for features) but is unused for Hilbert CRP.
subject_summary: Per cycle CRP on 101-pt grid; subject profile = circular mean across cycles (atan2 of mean sin/cos). Primary similarity = mean_t cos(CRP_i - CRP_j) (circular; preserves constant phase offsets that z-scored Pearson would destroy). Companion = DTW on unwrap(CRP-CRP[0]) for time-varying coupling shape.
